description: Get the tickers with the most congressional trades in CTA's records for the last N days. Set tx_type='Purchase' for most-bought tickers, or tx_type='Sale' for most-sold. Omit tx_type to rank purchases and sales together (default).

days.description: Look-back window in days, measured on trade date. Disclosures can arrive up to 45 days after the trade (later if filed late), so the newest part of any window is incomplete.

tx_type.description: Filter by transaction type: "Purchase" = buys only, "Sale" = sells only. Omit for all trades.

name: get_top_tickers
title: Top Tickers
